---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new skill, improvement, or capability
labels: enhancement
---

## The job to be done

Describe the outcome you are trying to reach, not the solution you have in mind. What does a business owner need to get done? What does success look like for them?

## Who this helps

Which type of operator or use case does this serve? (e.g. trades, consulting, finance, all businesses)

## Keyless or connected?

Would this work without any account or key (keyless floor), or would it need TrustPager or another integration?

- [ ] Keyless floor (no account needed)
- [ ] TrustPager connected
- [ ] Third-party integration (specify below)

If third-party: which service, and what credential does it need?

## Additional context

Anything else that would help the maintainers understand the request: examples, edge cases, related skills in the current library.
